question: Which of the following institution has released the "EnviStats India 2024: Environment Accounts"?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** is responsible for publishing the **EnviStats India** report annually, focusing on environmental accounts and related indicators.
 
• The **EnviStats India** report is a comprehensive document that compiles data on **environmental statistics** and **sustainable development indicators** in India.
 
• The report is prepared in accordance with the **United Nations System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA)**, which provides an international standard for environmental accounting.
 
• The **2024 edition** of EnviStats India emphasizes **climate action, biodiversity conservation**, and efforts to achieve **sustainable development goals (SDGs)**.
 
• The Ministry uses data from various sources, including **government departments, research organizations**, and international agencies, ensuring the accuracy and authenticity of the statistics provided.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**

 
 
• The MoSPI was established in **1999** with the aim of **streamlining statistical systems** in India and ensuring their alignment with international standards.
 
• It is responsible for **monitoring government programs** and **compiling national statistics** on various themes such as economy, environment, and society.
 
• Key divisions within MoSPI include the **Central Statistics Office (CSO)** and the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)**.
 
• MoSPI coordinates with the **UN Statistical Commission** and other global organizations to adopt and implement best practices in statistical reporting.
 
 
 
• **EnviStats India Report:**
 
 
• The **EnviStats India** report is published annually to provide insights into India's **natural resources, environmental degradation**, and **sustainable development efforts**.
 
• It covers topics such as **climate change, water resources, energy consumption, forest cover**, and **air pollution**.
 
• Data from EnviStats India is critical for policymaking, especially for achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** set by the United Nations.
 
• The report highlights India's progress in environmental conservation and identifies areas requiring improvement.
 
 
 
• **United Nations System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA):**
 
 
• The SEEA provides an internationally recognized framework for compiling environmental and economic statistics.
 
• It integrates **environmental data** with **economic accounts** to assess the interactions between the economy and the environment.
 
• The SEEA framework is crucial for tracking progress in achieving global environmental targets such as the **Paris Agreement** and SDGs.
 
• India's EnviStats report aligns with SEEA principles to ensure global comparability and credibility.
 
 
 
• **Other Ministries and Their Roles:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** focuses on environmental conservation, biodiversity protection, and climate action.
 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** oversees internal security but may contribute to disaster management efforts related to environmental hazards.
 
• The **Ministry of Cooperation** primarily deals with cooperative societies and does not play a direct role in environmental accounting.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of EnviStats India:**

 
 
• Provides **data-driven insights** into India's environmental challenges and opportunities.
 
• Supports the formulation of evidence-based policies for **sustainable development**.
 
• Contributes to **global environmental databases** and India's commitments under international agreements like the **Paris Climate Accord**.
 
 
 
• **Relevance of Environmental Accounts:**
 
 
• Helps track the impact of economic activities on **natural resources**.
 
• Guides investment decisions in **renewable energy** and **resource management**.
 
• Supports efforts to mitigate **climate change** and improve public health.
